LLM (Gemini gemini-2.5-flash) is called via LlmChat(...).with_model('gemini', GEMINI_MODEL).with_params(max_tokens=16000) — do NOT reduce max_tokens or the truncation bug returns. quicktest@example.com data must remain seeded (existing 'प्रकाश संश्लेषण' note is used by TestHindiStress).
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: Gemini's default max_tokens for LlmChat was small enough that long UPSC-style Hindi JSON arrays (multi-line 'कथनों पर विचार कीजिए' stems + 4 Hindi options + explanation × 5-10 MCQs) got truncated mid final object. json.loads on the whole '[...]' body then threw JSONDecodeError, the fallback also failed on the malformed tail, and generate_mcqs raised 'AI returned no valid MCQs'. FIX (verified working): (1) with_params(max_tokens=16000) gives ample headroom; (2) _extract_json_objects bracket-matches complete top-level {...} objects even if the array is truncated, salvaging every fully-formed MCQ; (3) trailing-comma cleanup; (4) stricter per-item validation (drop items with missing/empty options, normalize 1-4 to A-D) so one bad item can't poison the batch. REPRODUCTION was possible pre-fix; POST-fix cannot reproduce over 5 consecutive attempts (0/5 failures = 100% success). MITIGATION already in place — no further action needed.
